text: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is developing rapidly, and experts are discussing its future. Today, we have "narrow AI" that performs specific tasks like translation or driving. The next big step is Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), a system that can learn and think like a human across many areas. AGI could bring huge benefits, such as solving climate change or curing diseases. However, there are serious risks too, including job loss or loss of human control. Predictions about when AGI might arrive vary widely: some say 10 years, others say a century. One thing is clear—the future of AI will shape our world.
